title: noronhia foveolata subsp. major
intro: Noronhia foveolata subsp. major, commonly known as Madagascar Periwinkle, is a plant species belonging to the family Oleaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and the management of infections. The therapeutic actions of Noronhia foveolata subsp. major include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic actions.
